mapper.sql: select rdr.delivery_id, rdr.task_id, rdr.run_id, rdr.project_id, p.project_name, bs.system_name as business_system_name, rdr.provider, rdr.channel, rdr.pr_number, rdr.issue_id, rdr.idempotency_key, rdr.external_id, rdr.delivery_status, rdr.failure_message, rdr.attempt_count, rdr.next_attempt_at, rdr.last_error_code, rdr.lease_owner, rdr.lease_until, rdr.last_attempt_time, rdr.trigger_source, (case when rdr.content_snapshot is not null then 1 else 0 end) as has_content_snapshot, rdr.create_by, rdr.create_time, rdr.update_by, rdr.update_time from review_delivery_record rdr left join review_project p on p.project_id = rdr.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id
mapper.select: select content_snapshot from review_delivery_record where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, issue_id, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, lease_owner, lease_until, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, issue_id, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, lease_owner, lease_until, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where task_id = #{taskId} and channel in ('DINGTALK_ROBOT', 'WECOM_ROBOT', 'FEISHU_BOT') order by coalesce(last_attempt_time, create_time) desc, delivery_id desc limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, issue_id, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, lease_owner, lease_until, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where issue_id = #{issueId} and channel in ('GITHUB_PR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITLAB_MR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITEE_PR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITEA_PR_INLINE_COMMENT') order by delivery_id desc limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, issue_id, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, lease_owner, lease_until, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where task_id = #{taskId} and channel in ('GITHUB_PR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITLAB_MR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITEE_PR_INLINE_COMMENT', 'GITEA_PR_INLINE_COMMENT') order by delivery_id
mapper.insert: insert into review_delivery_record (task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, content_snapshot, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{runId}, #{projectId}, #{provider}, #{channel}, #{prNumber}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalId}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{failureMessage}, #{attemptCount}, #{lastAttemptTime}, #{triggerSource}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())

insert into review_delivery_record (task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, issue_id, idempotency_key, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error_code, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{runId}, #{projectId}, #{provider}, #{channel}, #{prNumber}, #{issueId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{failureMessage}, 0, sysdate()null, #{lastErrorCode}, #{triggerSource}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update delivery_id = last_insert_id(delivery_id), task_id = values(task_id), run_id = values(run_id), project_id = values(project_id), provider = values(provider), channel = values(channel), pr_number = values(pr_number), issue_id = values(issue_id), delivery_status = values(delivery_status), failure_message = values(failure_message), next_attempt_at = values(next_attempt_at), last_error_code = values(last_error_code), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, trigger_source = values(trigger_source), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select delivery_id from review_delivery_record where delivery_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') and next_attempt_at is not null and next_attempt_at <= sysdate() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < sysdate()) order by next_attempt_at, delivery_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update review_delivery_record set lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and delivery_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') and next_attempt_at is not null and next_attempt_at <= sysdate() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < sysdate())

update review_delivery_record set channel = coalesce(#{resolvedChannel}, channel), external_id = coalesce(#{externalId}, external_id), delivery_status = 'SUCCESS', failure_message = null, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_time = sysdate(), next_attempt_at = null, last_error_code = null, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null,
content_snapshot = #{contentSnapshot},
update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} and lease_until >= sysdate()

update review_delivery_record set delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_time = sysdate(), next_attempt_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{retryDelaySeconds} second) null , last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null,
content_snapshot = #{contentSnapshot},
update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} and lease_until >= sysdate()

update review_delivery_record set delivery_status = 'PENDING', failure_message = null, next_attempt_at = sysdate(), last_error_code = null, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, trigger_source = #{triggerSource}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and delivery_status in ('FAILED', 'MANUAL') and (lease_until is null or lease_until < sysdate())
update review_delivery_record set lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, update_time = sysdate() where lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} and delivery_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

update review_delivery_record set lease_until = date_sub(sysdate(), interval 1 second), last_error_code = 'DELIVERY_LEASE_EXPIRED', failure_message = '投递节点优雅停机超时，租约已置过期，等待恢复扫描接管', update_time = sysdate() where lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} and delivery_status = 'PENDING' and (lease_until is null or lease_until >= sysdate())

update review_delivery_record set delivery_status = 'SKIPPED', last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, next_attempt_at = null, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and delivery_status = 'MANUAL'
